title: His marriage and its end
summary: He describes his marriage to a woman with ten grandchildren, money troubles and leaving.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You don't have no family up there?

No, no. You see, I married a woman that had 10 grandchildren. And she busted me, see. She never did come to hear me play, anything like that. Never did. I was with her, I married her, I was with her eight years. And she never, not the first time. And so, these 10 grandchildren, I used to bring a couple of hands of bananas, maybe a little more of the 피ches. And all night in the morning, you hear tip, tip, tip, tip, tip. Tip, tip, tip. You know. You hear the head opening the door if I had anything in the box, you know. And so, the woman, she might have meant right but there was a lack of education. See, she's damn near illiterate, you know. And so she had a pretty good job and we'd sit down and talk. If she'd pull, if we pulled together, I still wouldn't have been playing music yet because we'd have made some money. But she would move, you know, and I wouldn't know if she'd move. She'd pass by my car and tell them I moved, something took the place. You know, one of them things like that. And if there was another woman in the building, like we had a front apartment, there was a woman in the back, and this woman came out one day in the booth, she was hanging there. She moved the next day. She was awfully jealous. And so, and then she said, well, let's get some money out the back. I said, again? Oh, we'll put it back. Nobody put it back. You keep drawing them, you just don't put it back. You understand? So she busted me. And then I got away from there, me and my dog. I just let her have all the furniture. Because she had set me up to be hurt. Yeah, her son came out of the army, he did ten years, and instead of doing another ten, he was only twenty-eight when he came out. See, in thirty-eight he'd been eligible for a pension.
So he came back and began to bulldoze.
